description: The theme guard window: a confirm-or-revert prompt shown while a theme activation is pending. It polls `get_activation_status` and answers with `confirm_activation` or `revert_activation`, and needs the window calls that let it appear and place itself. Deliberately not folded into `default`, which is scoped to `main` and carries `dialog:*`, `updater:*`, `shell:*`, window-close and `process:exit` — none of which a two-button prompt has any business reaching. This window renders theme-independent chrome only, so it loads no theme stylesheet and needs no theme permission.
